last.headline: Great shift with zero near-miss ships!
last.report: Fantastic shift today! We sorted 30 parcels with zero near-miss ships. The fast model averaged 124ms per decision. Our lanes handled 13 auto, 10 gemini, and 7 human sorts, with Gemini skipped 18 times. We filed 5 claims and had 0 blocked actions. Great job team!

changes.new_text: The box is intact, closed, or has only minor dents/surface wear even if marked fragile or containing fragile items (e.g. ceramics, glass, mirrors) as long as structural integrity remains sound. Send it on.
The box is severely crushed, torn, punctured, or wet. Minor dents on boxes containing fragile items do not require a hold unless the packaging itself is compromised.

last.rationale: For P-0108, P-0120, P-0123, and P-0130, Jev incorrectly held boxes because they had minor dents and fragile labels or contents. People decided to ship these intact boxes since the structural integrity was fine. We adjusted ship and hold to clarify that minor dents on otherwise sound boxes containing fragile items should be shipped.
